2026-08-31.content:
You can now create a Datastream stream directly from the overview page
of your Cloud SQL instances using the automated flow.

For more information, see
[Create a Cloud SQL stream using the automated flow](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/create-a-stream-automated).

summary.title: Datastream for Cloud SQL
summary.summary: Easily create Datastream streams directly from your Cloud SQL instances using the new automated flow. This feature simplifies the process of setting up data replication from Cloud SQL. For more details, refer to the documentation on creating a Cloud SQL stream via the automated flow.

2026-07-31.content:
You can now replicate change data from Workday with Datastream.
For more information, see
[Stream data from Workday](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/sources-workday).

This feature is in
[Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages).

summary.title: Workday data replication with Datastream
summary.summary: Datastream now supports replicating change data from Workday. This feature is currently in Preview and allows for easier integration of Workday data into your data pipelines.

2026-07-29.content:
You can now create a Datastream stream directly from the instance or
database overview page in Spanner using the automated flow.

For more information, see
[Create a Spanner stream using the automated flow](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/create-spanner-stream-automated).

summary.title: Create Datastream stream from Spanner
summary.summary: You can now create a Datastream stream directly from the Spanner instance or database overview page using an automated flow. This simplifies the process of setting up data replication from Spanner. For more details, refer to the documentation on creating Spanner streams with the automated flow.

2026-07-15.content:
You can now replicate change data from the following application sources with
Datastream:

* [ServiceNow](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/sources-servicenow)
* [Salesforce Marketing Cloud](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/sources-salesforce-marketing-cloud)
* [Microsoft Dataverse](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/sources-dataverse)

This feature is in
[Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages).

summary.title: New application source replication with Datastream
summary.summary: Datastream now supports replicating change data from ServiceNow, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and Microsoft Dataverse. This new feature is currently in Preview.

2026-06-02.content:
Datastream now offers a free tier for change data capture
(CDC) data processed from Google Cloud sources, such as
AlloyDB for PostgreSQL and Spanner. You get the first 100 GiB of
CDC data for free per billing account, per month.

For more information, see the [Pricing](https://cloud.google.com/datastream/pricing) page.

summary.title: Datastream offers free tier for CDC
summary.summary: Datastream now provides a free tier for change data capture (CDC) data processed from Google Cloud sources. Users receive the first 100 GiB of CDC data at no cost each month per billing account. This feature aims to make data replication more accessible and cost-effective.

2026-04-16.content:
You can now create a Datastream stream directly from the overview page
of your AlloyDB for PostgreSQL instance using the automated flow. The
automated flow simplifies the process of moving data to BigQuery by reducing the
number of steps that you need to perform.

For more information, see
[Create an AlloyDB for PostgreSQL stream using the automated flow](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/create-alloydb-stream-automated).

summary.title: Automated Datastream for AlloyDB
summary.summary: Create Datastream streams directly from your AlloyDB for PostgreSQL instance overview page with the new automated flow. This feature simplifies data movement to BigQuery by reducing manual steps. Get started quickly and efficiently move your data.

2026-04-10.content:
Datastream is now integrated with Knowledge Catalog.
This integration lets you search for and browse your Datastream
resources, such as streams, connection profiles, and connectivity configurations
directly in Knowledge Catalog.

For more information, see
[the documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/knowledge-catalog-integration).

summary.title: Datastream integration with Knowledge Catalog
summary.summary: Datastream is now integrated with Knowledge Catalog, allowing you to search and browse Datastream resources directly within Knowledge Catalog. This feature enhances discoverability and management of your data integration assets.

2026-04-07.content:
You can now use the
[Datastream remote MCP server](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/use-datastream-mcp)
to enable LLM agents to perform data-related tasks, such as managing and
monitoring your streams, connection profiles, and stream objects.

This feature is in
[Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages).

summary.title: New Datastream Remote MCP Server Available
summary.summary: A remote MCP server for Datastream is now available, allowing LLM agents to manage and monitor data-related tasks like streams and connection profiles. This feature is currently in Preview.

2026-01-28.content:
Datastream now supports Spanner as a source. For more
information, see the
[Datastream documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/sources-spanner).

summary.title: Datastream now supports Spanner
summary.summary: Datastream has added support for Spanner as a data source. This integration allows for seamless data replication from Spanner into other destinations. For more details, please refer to the Datastream documentation.

2025-11-17.content: Datastream now supports partitioning and clustering for BigQuery destinations. For more information, see [the documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/partitioning-and-clustering).

summary.title: Datastream BigQuery Integration
summary.summary: Datastream now supports partitioning and clustering for BigQuery destinations.

2025-09-30.content: Datastream support for Salesforce as a source is now [generally available (GA)](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages). For more information, see [the documentation](https://cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/sources-salesforce).

summary.title: Datastream for Salesforce
summary.summary: Datastream now supports Salesforce as a source, and it is generally available.

2025-09-23.content: Datastream support for MongoDB as a source is now [generally available (GA)](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages). For more information, see [the documentation](https://cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/sources-mongodb).

summary.title: Datastream MongoDB Source Now Available
summary.summary: Datastream now supports MongoDB as a source, which is now generally available.

2025-06-30.content: Datastream is now available in the `northamerica-south1` (Mexico) region. For the list of all available regions, see [IP allowlists and regions](https://cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/ip-allowlists-and-regions).

summary.title: Datastream now available in Mexico
summary.summary: Datastream is now available in Mexico (northamerica-south1). For more details, refer to the IP allowlists and regions documentation.

2025-06-23.content:
Datastream now supports BigLake Iceberg tables as a destination both in the
Google Cloud console and the Datastream API.

For more information, see the [Datastream documentation](https://cloud.google.com/datastream/docs/destination-blmt).

summary.title: Datastream supports BigLake Iceberg tables
summary.summary: Datastream now supports BigLake Iceberg tables as a destination, accessible via the Google Cloud console and the Datastream API.
